title: Rory and the Glowing Valley
verses:
The twilight was falling across the deep vale,
As Rory walked slowly to look at the sky.
A soft golden breeze whispered over his tail,
And Nia swooped down from the treetops on high.

"Come follow my wings," said the flyer with cheer,
"The lily-buds glow near the edge of the stream."
Then Ricky hopped out from the shadows so near,
While Psittaco chirped of a wonderful dream.

And Benny made room by the moss-covered stone,
Where Tilly laid down on a pillow of green.
The moss had a brightness uniquely its own,
The prettiest hollow that Rory had seen.

The stars started winking above the high trees,
As Psittaco settled inside a big leaf.
A sleepy song drifted along with the breeze,
To offer the tired young travelers relief.

Now Ricky yawned wide as he curled up to rest,
And Nia tucked softly her head in her wing.
Each dino felt cozy and peacefully blessed,
To listen to nightfall's sweet lullaby sing.

Then Rory stretched out in the soft glowing light,
And closed his big eyes as the forest grew still.
The valley was quiet and safe for the night,
As moonlight slept over the silvery hill.
